from the Visit Mesa one-page brand guide + logo art.\n   The four-color stripe (yellow → teal → orange) is an ACCENT,\n   never a wall-to-wall decoration.\n   ============================================================ */\n\n:root {\n  /* ---- Core brand palette (brand-guide swatches) ---- */\n  --vm-navy:        #1B3D6B;   /* primary brand color, deep field */\n  --vm-blue:        #2F6FAC;   /* secondary blue */\n  --vm-teal:        #41A2A8;   /* fresh accent */\n  --vm-orange:      #E07525;   /* energy / action accent */\n  --vm-yellow:      #FFB614;   /* sunlight / highlight accent */\n\n  /* ---- Logo-mark brights (use ONLY in the M mark / fine accents) ---- */\n  --vm-yellow-mark: #FFC709;\n  --vm-orange-mark: #F36E21;\n  --vm-blue-mark:   #336195;\n  --vm-teal-mark:   #038A96;\n\n  /* ---- Navy ramp ---- */\n  --vm-navy-900: #102744;\n  --vm-navy-800: #16335A;\n  --vm-navy-700: #1B3D6B;   /* = --vm-navy */\n  --vm-navy-600: #244e85;\n  --vm-navy-500: #2F6FAC;   /* = --vm-blue */\n  --vm-navy-400: #5b8fc4;\n  --vm-navy-300: #8fb3d8;\n  --vm-navy-200: #c2d6ea;\n  --vm-navy-100: #e3edf6;\n  --vm-navy-050: #f2f7fb;\n\n  /* ---- Teal ramp ---- */\n  --vm-teal-700: #2c7a80;\n  --vm-teal-500: #41A2A8;   /* = --vm-teal */\n  --vm-teal-300: #86c4c8;\n  --vm-teal-100: #dcefef;\n\n  /* ---- Orange ramp ---- */\n  --vm-orange-700: #b85a17;\n  --vm-orange-500: #E07525;   /* = --vm-orange */\n  --vm-orange-300: #f0a86e;\n  --vm-orange-100: #fce6d4;\n\n  /* ---- Yellow ramp ---- */\n  --vm-yellow-700: #c98a00;\n  --vm-yellow-500: #FFB614;   /* = --vm-yellow */\n  --vm-yellow-300: #ffd266;\n  --vm-yellow-100: #fff1cc;\n\n  /* ---- Neutrals (cool-warm desert grays) ---- */\n  --vm-ink:    #14233D;   /* near-navy black, primary text */\n  --vm-gray-900: #20303f;\n  --vm-gray-800: #38485a;\n  --vm-gray-700: #51606f;\n  --vm-gray-600: #6b7986;\n  --vm-gray-500: #8a96a1;\n  --vm-gray-400: #aab3bc;\n  --vm-gray-300: #cbd2d8;\n  --vm-gray-200: #e3e7eb;\n  --vm-gray-100: #f0f3f5;\n  --vm-gray-050: #f7f9fa;\n  --vm-white:  #FFFFFF;\n  --vm-sand:   #f6f1e7;   /* warm desert paper */\n\n  /* ============================================================\n     Semantic aliases — reference these in components/UI\n     ============================================================ */\n  --color-bg:            var(--vm-white);\n  --color-bg-subtle:     var(--vm-gray-050);\n  --color-bg-sand:       var(--vm-sand);\n  --color-surface:       var(--vm-white);\n  --color-surface-navy:  var(--vm-navy-700);\n  --color-surface-tint:  var(--vm-navy-050);\n\n  --color-text:          var(--vm-ink);\n  --color-text-muted:    var(--vm-gray-600);\n  --color-text-subtle:   var(--vm-gray-500);\n  --color-text-on-navy:  var(--vm-white);\n  --color-text-on-navy-muted: var(--vm-navy-200);\n  --color-text-link:     var(--vm-blue);\n\n  --color-primary:       var(--vm-navy-700);\n  --color-primary-hover: var(--vm-navy-800);\n  --color-primary-press: var(--vm-navy-900);\n  --color-accent:        var(--vm-orange-500);\n  --color-accent-hover:  var(--vm-orange-700);\n  --color-fresh:         var(--vm-teal-500);\n  --color-sun:           var(--vm-yellow-500);\n\n  --color-border:        var(--vm-gray-200);\n  --color-border-strong: var(--vm-gray-300);\n  --color-border-navy:   var(--vm-navy-200);\n  --color-ring:          var(--vm-blue);\n\n  /* status */\n  --color-success: #2f8f5b;\n  --color-warning: var(--vm-yellow-700);\n  --color-danger:  #c0392b;\n  --color-info:    var(--vm-blue);\n\n  /* the signature four-color stripe (accent only) */\n  --vm-stripe: linear-gradient(90deg,\n      var(--vm-yellow) 0%, var(--vm-yellow) 25%,\n      var(--vm-teal)   25%, var(--vm-teal)   50%,\n      var(--vm-orange) 50%, var(--vm-orange) 75%,\n      var(--vm-navy)   75%, var(--vm-navy)   100%);\n  --vm-stripe-soft: linear-gradient(90deg,\n      var(--vm-yellow), var(--vm-teal), var(--vm-orange));\n}\n<\u002Fstyle>\n<style>/* ============================================================\n   Visit Mesa — Typography */\n\n:root {\n  /* families */\n  --font-display: 'Montserrat', 'Tide Sans', system-ui, sans-serif;   /* Lulo substitute (Montserrat) */\n  --font-sans:    'Tide Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, major-third-ish, tightened for UI) */\n  --text-2xs: 0.6875rem;  /* 11px */\n  --text-xs:  0.75rem;    /* 12px */\n  --text-sm:  0.875rem;   /* 14px */\n  --text-md:  1rem;       /* 16px — base */\n  --text-lg:  1.125rem;   /* 18px */\n  --text-xl:  1.375rem;   /* 22px */\n  --text-2xl: 1.75rem;    /* 28px */\n  --text-3xl: 2.25rem;    /* 36px */\n  --text-4xl: 3rem;       /* 48px */\n  --text-5xl: 4rem;       /* 64px */\n  --text-6xl: 5.25rem;    /* 84px */\n\n  /* weights */\n  --fw-regular:  400; /* @kind font */\n  --fw-medium:   500; /* @kind font */\n  --fw-semibold: 600; /* @kind font */\n  --fw-bold:     700; /* @kind font */\n  --fw-extra:    800; /* @kind font */\n  --fw-black:    900; /* @kind font */\n\n  /* line-height */\n  --lh-tight:   1.04; /* @kind font */\n  --lh-snug:    1.18; /* @kind font */\n  --lh-normal:  1.5; /* @kind font */\n  --lh-relaxed: 1.65; /* @kind font */\n\n  /* letter-spacing */\n  --ls-display: 0.005em; /* @kind font */\n  --ls-eyebrow: 0.16em; /* @kind font */\n  --ls-tight:  -0.01em; /* @kind font */\n  --ls-normal: 0; /* @kind font */\n\n  /* ---- role tokens ---- */\n  --type-hero-size:    var(--text-6xl); /* @kind font */\n  --type-hero-weight:  var(--fw-black); /* @kind font */\n  --type-display-size: var(--text-4xl); /* @kind font */\n  --type-eyebrow-size: var(--text-xs); /* @kind font */\n  --type-body-size:    var(--text-md); /* @kind font */\n  --type-body-leading: var(--lh-relaxed); /* @kind font */\n}\n\n/* ------------------------------------------------------------\n   Optional utility classes (consumers may use directly)\n   ------------------------------------------------------------ */\n.vm-display {\n  font-family: var(--font-display);\n  font-weight: var(--fw-black);\n  text-transform: uppercase;\n  line-height: var(--lh-tight);\n  letter-spacing: var(--ls-display);\n}\n.vm-eyebrow {\n  font-family: var(--font-sans);\n  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);\n  text-transform: uppercase;\n  letter-spacing: var(--ls-eyebrow);\n  font-size: var(--text-xs);\n}\n.vm-body {\n  font-family: var(--font-body);\n  font-weight: var(--fw-regular);\n  font-size: var(--text-md);\n  line-height: var(--lh-relaxed);\n}\n<\u002Fstyle>\n<style>/* ============================================================\n   Visit Mesa — Spacing, Radii, Borders, Shadows, Motion\n   ============================================================ */\n\n:root {\n  /* ---- spacing scale (4px base) ---- */\n  --space-0:  0;\n  --space-1:  0.25rem;   /* 4  */\n  --space-2:  0.5rem;    /* 8  */\n  --space-3:  0.75rem;   /* 12 */\n  --space-4:  1rem;      /* 16 */\n  --space-5:  1.25rem;   /* 20 */\n  --space-6:  1.5rem;    /* 24 */\n  --space-8:  2rem;      /* 32 */\n  --space-10: 2.5rem;    /* 40 */\n  --space-12: 3rem;      /* 48 */\n  --space-16: 4rem;      /* 64 */\n  --space-20: 5rem;      /* 80 */\n  --space-24: 6rem;      /* 96 */\n\n  /* ---- radii ----  (Mesa avoids heavy rounded boxes — keep modest) */\n  --radius-xs: 3px;\n  --radius-sm: 5px;\n  --radius-md: 8px;\n  --radius-lg: 12px;\n  --radius-xl: 16px;\n  --radius-pill: 999px;\n  --radius-card: var(--radius-md);\n\n  /* ---- borders ---- */\n  --border-hair:  1px;\n  --border-thin:  1.5px;\n  --border-thick: 2px;\n  --border-accent: 4px;   /* the brand-color accent edge */\n\n  /* ---- elevation (soft, cool-navy tinted — never pure black) ---- */\n  --shadow-xs: 0 1px 2px rgba(20, 35, 61, 0.06);\n  --shadow-sm: 0 1px 3px rgba(20, 35, 61, 0.08), 0 1px 2px rgba(20, 35, 61, 0.06);\n  --shadow-md: 0 4px 12px rgba(20, 35, 61, 0.10), 0 2px 4px rgba(20, 35, 61, 0.06);\n  --shadow-lg: 0 12px 28px rgba(20, 35, 61, 0.14), 0 4px 10px rgba(20, 35, 61, 0.08);\n  --shadow-xl: 0 24px 56px rgba(20, 35, 61, 0.18);\n  --shadow-focus: 0 0 0 3px rgba(47, 111, 172, 0.35);  /* blue ring */\n\n  /* ---- layout ---- */\n  --container-sm: 640px;\n  --container-md: 880px;\n  --container-lg: 1120px;\n  --container-xl: 1320px;\n  --gutter: var(--space-6);\n\n  /* ---- motion ---- */\n  --ease-out:   cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); /* @kind other */\n  --ease-inout: cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1); /* @kind other */\n  --dur-fast:   120ms; /* @kind other */\n  --dur-base:   200ms; /* @kind other */\n  --dur-slow:   360ms; /* @kind other */\n}\n<\u002Fstyle>\n<style>/* ============================================================\n   Visit Mesa — Base / element defaults\n   (kept out of styles.css so that file stays @import-only)\n   ============================================================ */\n\n*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }\n\nhtml { -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; }\n\nbody {\n  margin: 0;\n  font-family: var(--font-body);\n  font-size: var(--text-md);\n  line-height: var(--lh-relaxed);\n  color: var(--color-text);\n  background: var(--color-bg);\n  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;\n  text-rendering: optimizeLegibility;\n}\n\nh1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 {\n  font-family: var(--font-sans);\n  color: var(--color-text);\n  line-height: var(--lh-snug);\n  margin: 0 0 0.5em;\n  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);\n  letter-spacing: var(--ls-tight);\n}\n\np { margin: 0 0 1em; }\n\na { color: var(--color-text-link); text-decoration: none; }\na:hover { text-decoration: underline; }\n\nstrong, b {  --text-sm:  0.875rem;   /* 14px */\n  --text-md:  1rem;       /* 16px — base */\n  --text-lg:  1.125rem;   /* 18px */\n  --text-xl:  1.375rem;   /* 22px */\n  --text-2xl: 1.75rem;    /* 28px */\n  --text-3xl: 2.25rem;    /* 36px */\n  --text-4xl: 3rem;       /* 48px */\n  --text-5xl: 4rem;       /* 64px */\n  --text-6xl: 5.25rem;    /* 84px */\n\n  /* weights */\n  --fw-regular:  400; /* @kind font */\n  --fw-medium:   500; /* @kind font */\n  --fw-semibold: 600; /* @kind font */\n  --fw-bold:     700; /* @kind font */\n  --fw-extra:    800; /* @kind font */\n  --fw-black:    900; /* @kind {\n  font-family: var(--font-display);\n  font-weight: var(--fw-black);\n  text-transform: uppercase;\n  line-height: var(--lh-tight);\n  letter-spacing: var(--ls-display);\n}\n.vm-eyebrow {\n  font-family: var(--font-sans);\n  font-weight: var(--fw-bold);\n  text-transform: uppercase;\n  letter-spacing: var(--ls-eyebrow);\n  font-size: var(--text-xs);\n}\n.vm-body {\n  font-family: Total room revenue divided by total available rooms — combines occupancy and rate into one efficiency metric.<\u002Fsc-raw-td><\u002Fsc-raw-tr>\n          <sc-raw-tr><sc-raw-td style=\"padding:8px 11px;border-bottom:1px solid #f0f3f5;font-weight:700;\">Occupancy Rate<\u002Fsc-raw-td><sc-raw-td style=\"padding:8px 11px;border-bottom:1px solid #f0f3f5;color:#51606f;\">Percentage of available hotel rooms that were sold on a given night or period.<\u002Fsc-raw-td><\u002Fsc-raw-tr>\n          <sc-raw-tr style=\"background:#f7f9fa;\"><sc-raw-td style=\"padding:8px 11px;border-bottom:1px solid #f0f3f5;font-weight:700;\">ROAS<\u002Fsc-raw-td><sc-raw-td style=\"padding:8px 11px;border-bottom:1px solid #f0f3f5;color:#51606f;\">Return on ad spend — revenue generated for every $1 spent on advertising. ORANGE : GRAY), borderRadius: 3 }] },\n      options: {\n        maintainAspectRatio: false,\n        plugins: { legend: { display: false }, tooltip: Object.assign({}, tip, { callbacks: { label: c => '+' + c.parsed.y + '% avg. monthly visitors YOY' } }) },\n        scales: { y: { grid: { color: '#f0f3f5' }, border: { display: false }, ticks: { callback: v => '+' + v + '%' } }, x: { grid: { display: false } } }\n      }\n    });\n\n    mk('impactChart', {\n      type: 'bar',\n      data: {\n        labels: ['Lodging','Food & Beverage','Retail','Transportation','Recreation'],\n        datasets: [{ data: [0.98, 0.82, 0.57, 0.52, 0.46], backgroundColor: [NAVY, TEAL, TEAL, TEAL, TEAL], borderRadius: 3 }]\n      },\n      options: {\n        indexAxis: 'y', maintainAspectRatio: false,\n        plugins: { legend: { display: false }, tooltip: Object.assign({}, tip, { callbacks: { label: c => '$' + c.parsed.x.toFixed(2) + 'M — ' + Math.round(c.parsed.x / 3.35 * 100) + '% of direct spend' } }) },\n        scales: { x: { grid: { color: '#f0f3f5' }, border: { display: false }, ticks: { callback: v => '$' + v + 'M' } }, y: { grid: { display: false } } }\n      }\n    });\n\n    mk('trafficChart', {\n      type: 'doughnut',\n      data: { labels: ['Organic search','Paid video','Direct','Other'], datasets: [{ data: [36.2, 31.4, 22.1, 10.3], backgroundColor: [NAVY, ORANGE, TEAL, GRAY], borderColor: '#fff', borderWidth: 3 }] },\n      options: { maintainAspectRatio: false, cutout: '58%', plugins: { legend: { position: 'right', labels: { boxWidth: 10, boxHeight: 10, usePointStyle: true, pointStyle: 'circle', padding: 10 } }, tooltip: Object.assign({}, tip, { callbacks: { label: c => c.label + ' — ' + c.parsed + '% of sessions' } }) } }\n    });\n  }\n\n  renderVals() {\n    return {\n      showGlossary: this.props.showGlossary ?? true,\n      menuOpen: this.state.menuOpen,\n      showQuick: () => this.setView('quick'),\n      showFull: () => this.setView('full'),\n      toggleMenu: () => this.setState(s => ({ menuOpen: !s.menuOpen })),\n      pickSection: (e) => {\n        const btn = e.target.closest('[data-target]');\n        if (!btn) return;\n        const id = btn.getAttribute('data-target');\n        this.setState({ menuOpen: false });\n        if (this.state.view !== 'full') this.setView('full');\n        setTimeout(() => {\n          const el = document.getElementById(id);\n          if (el) window.scrollTo({ top: el.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.pageYOffset - 74, behavior: 'smooth' });\n        }, 60);\n      },\n      jumpTo: (e) => {\n        const id = e.target.value;\n        if (!id) return;\n        const el = document.getElementById(id);\n        if (el) window.scrollTo({ top: el.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.pageYOffset - 74, behavior: 'smooth' });\n        e.target.selectedIndex = 0;\n      }\n    };\n  }\n}\n<\u002Fscript>\n\n\n<\u002Fbody><\u002Fhtml>"
  </script>
</body>
